 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 7971/2025 Deepak S/o Tulsiram, Aged About 27 Years, R/o 27 E Block, Near Maharshi Dadhich School And Rockwood School, Chitrakoot Nagar, P.s. Sukher, District Udaipur (Raj.) (Presently Lodged In District Jail Udaipur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Public Prosecutor.
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Tushar Moad For Respondent(s) : Ms. Sonu Manawat, PP  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 10/07/2025 1.

The instant bail application has been filed by the petitioner under Section 483 BNSS who has been arrested in connection with the FIR No.330/2024 dated 25.07.2024 registered at the Police Station Hiranmagri District Udaipur for the offences under Sections 406 and 420 of the IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case, as the allegation levelled against the petitioner is of cheating the complainant and extorting Rs.2,00,000/- in the name of District Judge, Udaipur in lieu of getting the land of the complainant removed from the green zone and getting a license for gun.
He further submits that the offences alleged against the petitioner are exclusively triable by the Court of Magistrate.
He also submits that the charge-sheet has been filed against the petitioner and is facing incarceration since 05.08.2024.

Thus, the petitioner deserves to be released on bail.
[2025:RJ-JD:30068] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-7971/2025]

1 3.

Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application, however, is not in a position to refute the fact that the offences alleged against the petitioner are triable by Magistrate and the fact that the charge-sheet has been filed.

4. Having considered the submissions advanced at Bar by learned counsel for the parties and having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances of the case as available on record; and looking to the fact that trial may take a long time to conclude and, without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court deems it fit to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
5. Consequently, the bail application is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused petitioner Deepak S/o Tulsiram arrested in connection with FIR No.330/2024 dated 25.07.2024 registered at the Police Station Hiranmagri District Udaipur shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, with a stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

(DR. NUPUR BHATI),J 149-/Devesh/-
